Name: Overgrown Flowery Interface Event Lookup Patch
Author: 2heartgirl
Description:
The small color clash between Event Lookup and my UI of choice brothered me so much I spent 15 minutes in photoshop color correcting to fix it. Thought I might as well upload this for anyone else who enjoys consistent color schemes.


[u][b]Install:[/b][/u]

[b]-> [/b]Unzip download from this page
[b]->[/b] Go to your Event Lookup mod
[b] ->[/b] Navigate to the folder inside Event Lookup labeled "assets"
[b] ->[/b] Drag and drop images from download into the assets folder
[b]->[/b] Replace/overwrite images when prompted
